messages:
maya: Trying to spin up a new A100 pool in eu-west-1 but getting blocked by account verification and a weird ENI quota error.
chris: Can you paste the error you see in the console/CLI?
maya: Console shows two things: 1) 'Account verification required: Business verification pending' banner on the EC2 dashboard, 2) when I try to launch Fleet: `InsufficientInstanceCapacity: Not enough available capacity or ENI quota exceeded` — full snippet:
```
An error occurred (InsufficientInstanceCapacity) when calling the RunInstances operation: You are attempting to exceed your VPC network interface quota.
Please contact support to increase your ENI limit or complete account verification.
```
raj: ENI limits are per-AZ per-account, and some A100 instance types create multiple ENIs. If the account isn't fully verified AWS tends to keep soft caps.
irina: billing-bot flagged the payment method earlier today, that might be why verification is stuck.
billing-bot: Payment attempt failed for acct ending 4127, reason: 3DSecure authentication required. Please update payment method in the billing console or contact payments@redwood.com.
maya: I updated the card but the business verification page still shows "documents required". I uploaded W-9 and company registration a few hours ago.
chris: Have we checked that the business name + tax ID on AWS match the docs exactly? AWS verification is picky about punctuation and spacing.
maya: Good call — our legal name on AWS is "Redwood Inference, Inc" but the W-9 I uploaded is "Redwood Inference Inc" (no comma). I'll re-upload with exact matching.
raj: Meanwhile, short-term workaround: try launching in us-west-2 where we've already got ENI headroom, or use smaller instance types until the verification clears.
maya: I tried us-west-2 but the model team needs europe region for latency. Could we request a temporary ENI increase for eu-west-1 while verification is pending?
chris: I'll open an AWS support case and mark it high priority with our account rep. Can someone confirm the billing contact and the exact org name we want AWS to see?
irina: Confirmed: billing contact payments@redwood.com. Org name to display: "Redwood Inference, Inc." with comma. Tax ID: XX-XXXXXXX.
chris: Filed support case #1234567-001. Message: "Account verification is blocking provisioning and ENI quota enforcement appears tied to verification state. Requesting emergency increase and expedited verification review. Attached W-9 and company cert. Contact: payments@redwood.com." (case created 1769802800)
aws-support-bot: Case 1234567-001 created. Estimated response within 24-48 hours. If payment issues exist, resolution may require billing team intervention.
maya: AWS just posted a note on the case saying they need a PDF of the government registration (we only sent a PNG). Uploading now.
chris: Also adding a note to the case that we can accept a temporary quota override for ENIs and A100 cores for eu-west-1 until verification completes. That should let the infra team finish smoke tests.
raj: Action items: chris to follow-up with AWS rep (he already did), maya to re-upload docs (doing now), billing to confirm card is 3DS-complete, and try to provision in alternate AZ if needed.
irina: Payments has confirmed the card and authorized the charge attempt; awaiting the 3DS callback confirmation.
maya: Thanks all — will update thread when AWS responds or when docs re-uploaded. If no response in 12 hrs @chris will escalate to our Salesforce rep.
chris: Yep, will escalate if no reply by 1769840000. :thumbsup:
